judge.rationale: The candidate's production code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is identical to the reference, moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. The candidate also provides a working unit test and a thorough `CHANGELOG.md` update covering the acceptance criteria. However, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate replaced the bullet in place under the `## Measured semantics — out of scope` section (leaving the surrounding text saying 'This issue changes none of them; each is a separate, out-of-scope change') rather than moving the new guarantee into the main spec section as the reference did and as the candidate's own `.lore/dod.md` noted. Additionally, the candidate created a separate test file (`chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts`) instead of adding the test to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, though this neatly avoided having to update line-number references in other spec files.
